thread:
nina: Heads-up: edge sample app failed after upgrading the SDK. import errors + auth retries not firing.

oliver: error text?

nina: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` when Vercel Edge loads `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk'`. Works in node.

kevin: prob an exports map mapping 'import' -> .cjs. bundlers in edge environments will try to parse as ESM.

nina: checked tarball: exports.import -> ./dist/index.cjs and exports has no types entry.

pat: that explains both runtime and TS issues (consumers see wrong shape). quick fix: publish patch where export.import -> ./dist/index.mjs and add types: ./dist/index.d.ts.

ci-bot: Suggestion: add a publish-lint step that validates export targets exist and have .mjs/.cjs extensions and that exports includes a types path.

oliver: also consider an automated edge-smoke job in release pipeline that installs the tarball and runs an import + auth flow in a lightweight edge runtime emulator.

kevin: long-term we should discuss dual artifacts (sdk + sdk-edge) vs stricter publish validation. I'll open a PR to fix the build script and add the lint.

nina: thanks — attaching failing tarball & minimal repro in the PR. I'll update onboarding samples after patch.
